correctness.rationale: PASS. A strictly increasing common cumulative-hazard transform maps independent proportional-hazard lifetimes to independent exponentials without changing rank concordance. Exponential race shows minimum M~Exp(Λ) independent of winner and maximum residual gap G. Inclusion–exclusion over nonempty proper S yields density ∑c_S r_S exp(−r_S x), c_S=(−1)^{|S|+1}(Λ−r_S)/Λ. For independent copies the difference M−M’ is Laplace and conditional discordance probability is [1−exp(−Λ|G−G’|)]/2, hence τ=E exp(−Λ|G−G’|). Direct pairwise exponential integration yields the submitted finite rational double sum; all denominators positive, with no infinite rearrangements. Independently evaluated the double sum in exact fractions for [1,1], [1,2], [1,3], [2,7], [1,2,3], [1,1,1], [1,1,1,1], [1,2,4,8]. For two rates τ=(1−t)(3−t)/(9−t), derivative negative on 0≤t<1 and endpoint slopes −11/27, −1/4; the stated inverse recovers only UNORDERED ratio, not scale or labels.
